name: rail-highway-pay
about: A sound ad: a white tractor and van on a prairie highway at dusk, the pay below it. Redrawn for L5 (ADS-AD-LOOK-PLAN) in the new renderer's `rail` look (left rule, Barlow Condensed headline, drawn button, the kit's band at the foot): the same photo, words and kit as `clean-highway-pay`, which is the same ad in the old overlay.

truth.how: nothing planted: the subject is clear, the plate is the kit's green, the headline over the truck

subject_legible.reason: A white tractor and trailer in full side profile on an open highway at sunset reads instantly at phone size.

words_match_picture.reason: A per-mile pay and OTR headline sits over a long-haul truck on an open highway, which fits the story though pay itself is not pictured.

hierarchy_reads.reason: The big white headline on the green wash leads and the white button follows clearly, with only a faint road line behind the text and an empty footer band.

looks_like_kit.reason: The dark green overlay, footer band and button text with white lettering match the brand colours, but no logo was supplied and no carrier name appears.
